name: Nosois' Vengeance
description: The sparrow on the scroll animates, speaking to the PCs in Noguchi's voice (one of the nosois from Event 11: Nosois' Brunch): "They're the ones! They're the blasphemers who can't even properly serve tea! Send them along to the Lady!"
disable: DC 36 Thievery check (to quickly destroy the scroll without triggering the hazard), DC 33 Religion check (to apologize to Pharasma and the nosois for the previous insult), or dispel magic (6th level; counteract DC 29).

offensiveAbilities.name: Summon Vanths
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger One of the PCs enters the room and is noticed by the hazard

Effect The trap summons four vanths, who then roll initiative and remain for up to 1 minute before the spell ends and the vanths disappear. The summoned vanths can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.
